description: You're preparing for a neighborhood garage sale this Saturday. Open the spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/garage_sale_items.xlsx which contains ~45 items but has incomplete data. Your task: (1) Fill in missing prices for items that don't have one, (2) Standardize and complete the Category column, (3) Add a 'Minimum Price' column in Column D using formulas to calculate 75% of asking price, (4) Create a summary section with Total Revenue, Minimum Revenue, Item Count, and Average Price (all using formulas), (5) Sort the data by Category then by Price (descending), (6) Format headers as bold. Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
